notes.title: SFX, Level 5, Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Another small update is ready for level 5 and SFX sound settings are also possible

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
When a platform moved, there were horrible noises, but they are no longer there
When you died, there were 2 seconds and if you changed your skin in the meantime, you were stuck there, [b]now if you change skin during the game, the level will start over!![/b]
